newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Protest to save Grundig jobs in Portugal.
newsitem.headline: Protest to save Grundig jobs in Portugal.

text.p: Several hundred workers invaded the premises of a car radio factory of German company Grundig in northern Portugal on Thursday to protest against plans to dismiss 114 of their colleagues, witnesses said.
They said the workers turned off the electricity and forced the factory in the city of Braga to halt production.
Later, protesters stood outside the factory gates to press demands for the reinstatement of the workers.
Spokesmen at the factory were not immediately available.
The factory was closing down its hi-fi unit, local media reports said.

Protesters blocked a main road in Braga all day on Wednesday. They went home after receiving assurances from Employment Minister Maria Joao Rodrigues that the government would offer professional training to the dismissed workers, but renewed their protests on Thursday.
